comments.body: I really think that we should just *stop drawing* in this case, e.g. if the context-menu is opened, since having drawing continue if the mouse if moved outside of the context-menu seems unexpected/wrong.
These changes look unneeded, since I don't believe that any logical changes happened here?
Nit: In the existing code we're using `path2D`, note the capitalization, so can we perhaps use a consistent local variable name through this file to prevent surprises/issues later on?
